title: Avro car in NASA wind tunnel
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Avro car in NASA wind tunnel, about 1961 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: an Avro car in 1961 in an NASA wind tunnel.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions the Avrocar, a round, saucer-shaped experimental aircraft, being tested in a NASA wind tunnel in 1961. He raises it in a talk about antigravity, as evidence that the US government was seriously working on flying-saucer designs.
